# viettelcloud_volume_snapshot (Data Source)

Get one Viettel Cloud Block Storage volume snapshot by ID or exact filter criteria.

## Example Usage

```terraform
variable "volume_id" {
  type = string
}

data "viettelcloud_volume_snapshot" "data" {
  name      = "example-data-snapshot"
  volume_id = var.volume_id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) Snapshot ID (UUID).
- `name` (String) Snapshot name to filter by.
- `status` (String) Snapshot status to filter by.
- `volume_id` (String) Source volume ID (UUID) to filter by.
- `zone` (String) Source volume zone name to filter by.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation time (RFC3339).
- `description` (String) Snapshot description.
- `from_policy` (Boolean) Whether a policy created the snapshot.
- `project_id` (String) Project ID (UUID).
- `size` (Number) Snapshot size in GiB.
- `updated_at` (String) Last update time (RFC3339).
- `volume_name` (String) Source volume name.
- `zone_id` (String) Source volume zone ID (UUID).
